p: A Japanese general affairs team of three, two women and one man in navy business suits, standing together around a tidy desk with a blank laptop, a phone and neat blank folders, next to a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face.
A tired office worker in a navy business suit searching through tall stacks of blank binders and folders at a desk, hand on forehead, looking for a rule in a blank handbook.
A woman in a navy business suit at a desk writing a blank memo together with a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face, who hands her a neat blank draft page.
A busy office worker in a navy business suit at a desk answering a desk phone while moving blank forms from one tall tray of paper to another, with several blank request sheets piling up around him.

A man in a navy business suit at a desk reviewing one tidy blank meeting summary page, beside a laptop showing a blank video meeting grid. A large friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face, fully opaque with a soft light sky blue edge and clearly visible, stands on the desk and hands him the page.

A female factory shift leader in a work uniform at night, with a moon visible through a window, reading a short blank summary sheet on a tablet held out by a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face.
A woman in a navy business suit at a laptop, while a long chain of blank envelopes is folded into one short tidy blank page by a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face.
A woman in a navy business suit at head office posting a blank notice on a large screen, connected by simple lines to three small shop buildings where staff in aprons hold tablets and raise a hand.

A receptionist woman in a navy business suit wearing a headset at a desk, with simple lines from one telephone handset branching out to three colleagues in different places, one at home with a laptop, one in an office and one outdoors with a smartphone.
An employee in a navy business suit asking a question to a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face, which holds open a blank rule book with one line highlighted in amber.

A woman in a navy business suit and a male colleague sitting across a small table for a one-on-one talk, beside a large blank calendar grid with some empty time slots highlighted in amber, without characters.
A man in a navy business suit watching blank form sheets slide from a tablet into one neat blank ledger table on a large monitor, each new row marked with a small amber tag, without characters.

A woman manager in a navy business suit checking a blank request sheet on a tablet, with a large check mark, while a stamped blank document moves along a simple path of three circles into a neat storage box, without characters.

A man in a navy business suit at a desk looking at a blank checklist with most rows ticked and two rows marked amber, while small blank envelopes fly from a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face toward two colleagues.
